# fluentd

**Tag**: data

## 简介

Fluentd is an open source data collector designed to scale and simplify log management. It can collect, process and ship many kinds of data in near real-time.

## 官网

- 主页: https://www.fluentd.org/
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/fluent/fluentd
- 更新日志: https://github.com/fluent/fluentd/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md
- 问题追踪: https://github.com/fluent/fluentd/issues
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/fluentd
